items.en: Yesterday I had a job interview.
The interview went well.

items.dari: من برای این کار آماده بودم.
items.en: I was ready for this job.
items.translit: Man barāy-e in kār āmāda budam.

items.en: The company manager asked many questions.
I answered the questions.
Tomorrow I will get the interview result.

items.dari: این کار برای من مهم است.
items.en: This job is important to me.
items.translit: In kār barāy-e man mohem ast.

items.en: I had an appointment with the doctor.
The doctor examined me.

items.dari: داکتر گفت که من باید استراحت کنم.
items.en: The doctor said I should rest.
items.translit: Daktar goft ke man bāyad esterāhat konam.

items.en: I took medicine.

items.dari: بعد از چند روز خوب شدم.
items.en: After a few days I got better.
items.translit: Ba'd az chand roz khub shodam.

items.en: The appointment was at ten o'clock.
I am not sick anymore.
Today there was a lot of traffic.
I got stuck in traffic.
The driver drove slowly.
The road was crowded today.
I arrived late to work.
The police controlled the traffic.
Tomorrow I must go earlier.
Do not throw trash in the street.
Yesterday we cleaned the park.
Air pollution is a big problem.

items.dari: ما باید محیط را پاک نگه داریم.
items.en: We must keep the environment clean.
items.translit: Mā bāyad mohit rā pāk negah dārim.

items.dari: درخت‌های بیشتر هوا را پاک می‌کنند.
items.en: More trees clean the air.
items.translit: Derakht-hā-ye bishtar hawā rā pāk mikonand.

items.en: This city has a lot of pollution.
We collected the trash.

items.dari: هفته گذشته به یک عروسی رفتم.
items.en: Last week I went to a wedding.
items.translit: Hafta-ye gozashta ba yak arusi raftam.

items.en: The wedding was very big.
All the guests were happy.
At the wedding there was a lot of music.
The bride wore a white dress.

items.dari: ما تا شب در عروسی بودیم.
items.en: We were at the wedding until night.
items.translit: Mā tā shab dar arusi budim.

items.en: The wedding food was delicious.
Last year I fasted.

items.dari: در رمضان صبح زود بیدار می‌شویم.
items.en: In Ramadan we wake up early in the morning.
items.translit: Dar ramazān sobh zud bidār mishawim.

items.en: Our iftar was with dates.

items.dari: خانواده من با هم افطار کردند.
items.en: My family broke the fast together.
items.translit: Khānawāda-ye man bā ham eftār kardand.

items.en: At dawn we must eat.
Ramadan is a blessed month.

items.dari: روزه گرفتن سخت بود اما خوب بود.
items.en: Fasting was hard but it was good.
items.translit: Roza gereftan sakht bud ammā khub bud.

items.en: This morning I read the newspaper.
There was big news in the newspaper.

items.dari: من هر روز خبرها را می‌خوانم.
items.en: I read the news every day.
items.translit: Man har roz khabar-hā rā mikhwānam.

items.en: This news was interesting.
My father bought the newspaper.
Today's news was not good.
The newspaper is cheap at the market.

items.dari: دیروز به معلم خود ایمیل نوشتم.
items.en: Yesterday I wrote an email to my teacher.
items.translit: Diroz ba mo'alim-e khod imeil neveshtam.

items.en: Did my email arrive?
He/She sent me an email.
I have not read the email yet.
The company email was important.
Please write me an email.
My email arrived late.

items.dari: دیروز با داکتر تیلفونی صحبت کردم.
items.en: Yesterday I spoke with the doctor by phone.
items.translit: Diroz bā daktar telefoni sohbat kardam.

items.en: I made the appointment by phone.
He/She did not answer my call.
items.translit: U telefon-e ma rā jawāb nadād.

items.en: I called again.
Our conversation was short.

items.dari: وقت ملاقات فردا ساعت نه است.
items.en: The appointment is tomorrow at nine o'clock.
items.translit: Waqt-e molāqāt fardā sā'at-e noh ast.

items.dari: او گفت که وقت را فراموش نکنم.
items.en: He/She said not to forget the appointment.
items.translit: U goft ke waqt rā farāmosh nakonam.

items.dari: من از این مشکل شکایت کردم.
items.en: I complained about this problem.
items.translit: Man az in moshkel shekāyat kardam.

items.dari: این موبایل از اول خراب بود.
items.en: This mobile phone was broken from the start.
items.translit: In mobail az awwal kharāb bud.

items.en: I complained to the manager.
The problem has not been solved yet.
The company did not answer my complaint.
items.translit: Sherkat jawāb-e shekāyat-e ma rā nadād.

items.dari: من دیگر از این دوکان چیزی نمی‌خرم.
items.en: I will not buy anything from this shop anymore.
items.translit: Man digar az in dokān chizi nemikharam.

items.en: Finally my problem was solved.
